title:
Epic triggered on clicking `Dismiss` button on any card in `ParsingJobsSidePanelCardList`.
If the {@link UploadedFileCollection#parsingStatus} is {@link ParsingStatusEnum#COMPLETED} or {@link ParsingStatusEnum#FAILED},
 Dismissing card would remove the corresponding entity.
else
 Dismissing card would set {@link UploadedFileCollection#userDismissed} field to true, which hides it from being shown in the cardList.

The epic also refreshes any relevant datasourceIds passed in payload.
